title: UCSL Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 11 Trade Apprentice Posts
description: Udupi Cochin Shipyard (UCSL) has declared the latest job notification for the recruitment of 11 Trade Apprentice Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in the 10th Pass or ITI can use this opportunity and apply for the UCSL Notification 2026 . Here we provide more details about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
